text:
Maya Chen: Morning team — Day-of checklist for CloudMarket + EdgeGPU joint webinar (2pm PT). Signal flow + fallbacks below. Need final owners for each bullet by EOD.

- Primary stream: Zoom -> OBS (Sam) -> Streamhost RTMP
- Backup 1: Direct RTMP from presenter laptop -> Streamhost
- Backup 2: Pre-recorded demo on S3 -> local encoder
- Speaker fallback: pre-recorded answer set (Ravi to own)
- Demo fallback: canned demo video + screenshots (Alex)
- Swag pick-up: onsite courier arrives 12:30 (Lena)

Notes:
- Presenters: CloudPartner (A. Nguyen), EdgeGPU (S. Ito), Redwood demo leads (Ravi, Alex)
- Need slides + demo VM snapshots by 11:30 PT
- Can Sam confirm RTMP creds & ingest URL?

Thanks :pray:

Sam O'Neill: Got it. I'll set up OBS scene names and PM RTMP creds here. RTMP URL: rtmp://stream.redwood.com/live/abc123
I'll run a 15-min AV check 1pm PT. Who's on for the check?

Ravi Patel: I'll record 2-min fallback answers for common Qs and upload to S3 (private link). Will do by 10:30 PT.

Alex Gomez: Demo snapshots done. If live model hits quota, fallback video is ready. Also adding captions to video. I'll jot the runbook snippet:
```
if model_error -> switch to video.mp4 -> notify slack #partnerships
```

Lena Martin: Swag courier confirmed. Pickup at 12:00, arriving 12:30. Need packing list confirmation — who has final quantities?

Maya Chen: I have final list in Google Sheet - linked: https://short.link/swag-list — 200 stickers, 50 tees, 20 demo USBs. Sam pls bring spare table labels.

Sam O'Neill: bringing labels + power strips. AV check volunteers: Maya, Ravi, Alex, Sam. Count me in.

LogisticsBot: Calendar invite updated with AV check at 13:00 PT and dry-run at 14:00 PT. Reminder 15m before.

Lena Martin: Can someone confirm speaker bios for the livestream overlay?

Maya Chen: I'll add bios to the overlay file; Ravi send headshots by 10:00.

Ravi Patel: Sent headshot to Maya via email. Also uploaded final slide deck to Drive (folder: /CloudMarket-edge-demo).

Sam O'Neill: All set on my side. I'll post RTMP creds in a DM and attach the OBS scene export here after the 11:00 rehearsal. :thumbsup:
